mapper.insert: insert into models (model_name, brand, scale, manufacturer, grade, description, color, limited_edition, shop_id, owner_id, status, image, created_at, updated_at, update_user,price) values (#{modelName}, #{brand}, #{scale}, #{manufacturer}, #{grade}, #{description}, #{color}, #{limitedEdition}, #{shopId}, #{ownerId}, #{status}, #{image}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}, #{updateUser},#{price})
mapper.select: SELECT m.id, m.model_name, m.brand, m.manufacturer, m.image, m.scale, m.grade, m.description, m.color, m.limited_edition, m.status, m.created_at, m.updated_at, m.update_user, m.price, u.username AS owner_name, s.platform AS shop_name FROM models m LEFT JOIN User u ON m.owner_id = u.id LEFT JOIN shop s ON m.shop_id = s.id where m.owner_id = #{ownerId}
